t: The classic Arduino UNO shape with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and a tiny light grid.
steps: Buy the board from the Arduino store or a maker shop.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE, or open the Arduino web editor.
Add the board package for UNO R4 boards in the Boards Manager.
Plug in the board and pick Arduino UNO R4 WiFi from the board menu.
Open the Blink example and press Upload. The small light on the board starts to blink.
Try the LED matrix examples next to draw on the light grid.
meta: Open Board. From $20.62. A few stores.
